text:
Platinum Price in 1997
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1997, the LBMA platinum price rose 3.3% between 1997-01-31 ($351) and 1997-12-30 ($363). The highest sampled price was $435 in July and the lowest was $351 in January. The mean of these observations was $397. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
